notes: The English title concerns errors in the first 100 pages of notes plus the letter to Quillen. The page is a correction list in another unnamed hand, with two named sections.

The Quillen-letter section contains five entries: p5 line 14; p5 line 15; p5 prime line 11; line -16; and p6 prime line -13. The commute and standard corrections are marked repeated. The p5 line 15 wording is qualified as would be more normal.
The Reflections section contains twelve numbered page references, from p1 through p41. The p5 line 11 suggestion is qualified as would be more usual.
At p21 line 12 the writer says n-tuples is I believe correct. At p32 line 17, explicitly identified as middle of page, the suggestion is introduced by probably.

The p34 line 6 phrase is called not clear in sense. The writer explains the usual object construction with allow and to, but says the suggested which allow one to does not seem right here; Allow for is different is a separate paragraph.
The final entry prefers we have to we got, calls the latter American, and connects it by a therefore sign to older English. The connector between 16th and 17th remains ambiguous.
No date or internal manuscript page number appears. The pencilled lower-left 16 is recorded as the archive sheet number. There are no displays, diagrams or drawings.
